description.short: Proposes knowledge from this team's channels, where its admins turn capture on.
description.full: Aerugo reads this team's standard channels once its owner adds the app, each post readable only by the team's members. A channel is captured only when its team's admin in Aerugo confirms it; the bot then posts a notice there. Anyone in the team can choose Don't capture on a message to keep it out. Private and shared channels, group chats, and 1:1 chats are never read.

commands.title: Don't capture
commands.description: Keep this message out of Aerugo

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.title: Keep this message out of Aerugo
parameters.description: Aerugo won't keep or propose from it again.
